Summary.FirstTierDoctrine: IRLT, compounding pharmacy, and DSCSA remain equal first-tier commercialization and demonstration tracks.
Summary.HumanAuthorityRule: Qualified humans and authorized organizational roles retain binding authority.
Summary.SourceOfTruthRule: Official records and executed actions remain in governed source systems.

Step166CandidateScope.ProposedTitle: First-Tier Triad Commercial Demonstration Console and Inspection Passport Bundle
Step166CandidateScope.Purpose: Implement a local synthetic read-only demonstration console over the verified Step 164 API for IRLT, compounding pharmacy, and DSCSA. The console will display baseline, tamper, domain-failure, recovery, passport, RAMAT, reconstruction, and audit evidence.

Display the same expiring DISPLAY / WITNESS ONLY state intended for wearable presentation.

Step166CandidateScope.SecurityBoundary: Localhost only; synthetic data only; GET-only API; no secrets in browser; no production connection; no source-system write-back.
ExplicitExclusions: No real shipment or product transfer
Step166CandidateScope.AuthorizationReason: Step 166 requires a new explicit accountable-human authorization after Step 165 review.

ReleaseGates.Requirement: An accountable human must explicitly authorize Step 166 after reviewing Step 165.
IRLT, compounding pharmacy, and DSCSA remain equal first-tier tracks.
Platform B v1 remains limited to its six frozen MVP capabilities.
Commercial demonstration orchestration remains inside Platform B1 / MVP2.
Thread D2 and RAMAT Vision remain DISPLAY / WITNESS ONLY.
The console and API may read synthetic state but may not perform write-back or regulated execution.
Qualified humans and authorized organizational roles retain binding authority.
Official records and execution remain in governed source systems.
Only synthetic records, mock identities, and non-production services may be used.
Missing, stale, conflicted, invalid, or compromised conditions must create or preserve ACTION HELD.
SHA-256 sealing, rehashing, tamper detection, recovery, tests, and artifact integrity remain mandatory.

CommercialTracks.StrategicPosition: Equal first-tier commercialization and demonstration priority
CommercialTracks.PrimaryAudience: Compounding pharmacies; pharmacists; Quality teams; healthcare organizations; inspectors; commercialization partners; investors
CommercialTracks.DemonstrationStory: A synthetic patient-specific preparation moves from mock order and formula through ingredient genealogy, calculation, preparation, labeling, pharmacist review, beyond-use timing, and dispensing readiness.
CommercialTracks.BaselineProof: Verified order, formula, ingredients, calculations, label, timing, evidence, and pharmacist authority produce ACTION ADMISSIBLE.
CommercialTracks.FailureProof: Evidence tampering or label mismatch produces REHASH_MISMATCH or DEPENDENCY UNSATISFIED, NO-BIND STATE ACTIVE, and ACTION HELD.
CommercialTracks.RecoveryProof: Verified restoration and corrected label state return the synthetic preparation to REHASH_VERIFIED and ACTION ADMISSIBLE.
CommercialTracks.PassportOutput: Compounding Preparation and Pharmacist Assurance Passport
CommercialTracks.ConsoleView: Order identity; formula version; ingredient genealogy; calculations; label agreement; beyond-use timing; pharmacist authority; No-Bind; admissibility; reconstruction
CommercialTracks.HumanAuthority: Authorized prescriber context, qualified compounding personnel, authorized pharmacist, and accountable pharmacy management
CommercialTracks.SourceSystemBoundary: Mock pharmacy, formulation, inventory, equipment, environmental, label, and dispensing systems remain authoritative.
CommercialTracks.ReleaseStatus: PROPOSED STEP 166 DEMONSTRATION RELEASE - NOT IMPLEMENTED

CommercialTracks.StrategicPosition: Equal first-tier commercialization and demonstration priority
CommercialTracks.PrimaryAudience: Manufacturers; wholesalers; dispensers; trading partners; supply-chain compliance teams; regulators; commercialization partners; investors
CommercialTracks.DemonstrationStory: A synthetic serialized product moves from manufacturer through aggregation, EPCIS events, transaction evidence, trading-partner authority, custody transfer, verification, suspect-product review, and disposition readiness.
CommercialTracks.BaselineProof: Verified serial, lot, aggregation, EPCIS sequence, partner authority, transaction evidence, and suspect-product clearance produce ACTION ADMISSIBLE.
CommercialTracks.FailureProof: Evidence tampering or broken EPCIS sequence produces REHASH_MISMATCH or DEPENDENCY UNSATISFIED, NO-BIND STATE ACTIVE, and ACTION HELD.
CommercialTracks.RecoveryProof: Verified restoration and corrected EPCIS sequence return the synthetic product to REHASH_VERIFIED and ACTION ADMISSIBLE.
CommercialTracks.PassportOutput: DSCSA Transaction, Trading-Partner, and Custody Assurance Passport
CommercialTracks.ConsoleView: Product identity; aggregation; EPCIS chronology; transaction evidence; trading-partner authority; suspect-product state; No-Bind; admissibility; reconstruction
CommercialTracks.HumanAuthority: Authorized manufacturer, trading-partner, supply-chain, compliance, Quality, investigation, and disposition roles
CommercialTracks.SourceSystemBoundary: Mock serialization, EPCIS, ERP, warehouse, trading-partner, verification, and investigation systems remain authoritative.
CommercialTracks.ReleaseStatus: PROPOSED STEP 166 DEMONSTRATION RELEASE - NOT IMPLEMENTED

CommercialTracks.StrategicPosition: Equal first-tier commercialization and demonstration priority
CommercialTracks.PrimaryAudience: Radiopharmaceutical manufacturers; Quality Units; clinical sites; logistics partners; regulators; investors; research collaborators
CommercialTracks.DemonstrationStory: A synthetic AURORA-17 batch moves from QC release through custody, transport, receiving-site readiness, decay-window control, and administration readiness.
CommercialTracks.BaselineProof: Verified evidence, identity, dependencies, authority, timing, and custody produce ACTION ADMISSIBLE while official execution remains external.
CommercialTracks.FailureProof: Evidence tampering or custody discontinuity produces REHASH_MISMATCH or DEPENDENCY UNSATISFIED, NO-BIND STATE ACTIVE, and ACTION HELD.
CommercialTracks.RecoveryProof: Verified restoration and corrected custody state return the synthetic case to REHASH_VERIFIED and ACTION ADMISSIBLE.
CommercialTracks.ConsoleView: Batch identity; evidence integrity; custody chain; decay timing; authority; No-Bind; admissibility; RAMAT display state; reconstruction timeline
CommercialTracks.HumanAuthority: Quality Unit, authorized batch releaser, radiation-safety role, logistics custodian, receiving authority, and qualified clinical personnel
CommercialTracks.SourceSystemBoundary: Mock MES, LIMS, eQMS, ERP, custody, logistics, and clinical systems remain authoritative.
CommercialTracks.ReleaseStatus: PROPOSED STEP 166 DEMONSTRATION RELEASE - NOT IMPLEMENTED
